en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing an ornate Baroque/Classicist town hall façade with statues on the roof, elaborate window decorations, and a wrought‑iron balcony above an arched central entrance. The street in front is almost empty, with a few pedestrians and old-style street lamps. At the top in red lettering appears a place name and the word for town hall in Hungarian, while shop signage (including 'MAURER ADOLF') is visible at street level.
